verdict.rationale: ReelMimic generates 2D animated videos with characters and supports TTS voices (Yating, ElevenLabs), so a lip-sync story is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only describes those voices as being 'for narration.' Nothing in the pack shows characters speaking dialogue with mouth movement matched to the audio, so TTS narration is only an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio
